messages:
maria_sales: Hey all — Orchard Finance confirmed they want a 6-week POC. Main objectives they shared: 1) automated statement summarization for end users, 2) support ticket triage + suggested responses, 3) explainable fraud-alert messages for customers. They want a prioritized list of user journeys, success criteria, and a short eval plan by EOD Friday. Also they asked if Hosted API is enough or whether Dedicated capacity is required given expected load (details below).

maria_sales: Quick context: they estimate ~15 rps peak across all flows, average ~600 tokens produced per end-to-end flow, bursty during statements (end of month). Security: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS required, procurement wants an answer on data retention and audit logs.

jon_engineering: Thanks — high level this looks doable on Hosted for an initial POC if we tune batching and caching, but Dedicated reserved capacity makes sense if they need strict latency SLOs or can't tolerate throttling during month-end bursts. From runtime perspective, prioritize low-latency paths for support triage (short responses) and throughput-optimized paths for statement summarization (longer outputs).

jon_engineering: Proposed prioritized journeys for POC: 
- 1) Support triage endpoint: quick classification + suggested reply (SLO: 200ms p95 for classification, 300ms p95 for suggested reply).
- 2) Statement summarization endpoint: condense monthly statement into 3 bullet highlights (SLO: 800ms p95, accuracy > 85% on info recall).
- 3) Fraud-explain endpoint: given transaction + rules, produce customer-facing explanation with masked PII (SLO: 350ms p95, human rating > 4/5).

caleb_solutions: For the POC eval plan I suggest: automated metrics + small human panel. Automated: token-level ROUGE / BLEU isn’t perfect for these tasks; prefer information-recall tests and intent classification accuracy. Human: 20 business users rate helpfulness and safety. Example success criteria (POC pass = all must meet):
- Support triage: classification F1 >= 0.88, suggested reply acceptance >= 60% (seeded tickets).
- Summary: recall of top-3 events >= 0.85 across 50 statements.
- Fraud-explain: human helpfulness avg >= 4.0/5 on 30 samples, no privacy leaks.

caleb_solutions: Example prompt snippet for summarization we can test: 
```
system: You are a concise banking assistant.
user: Summarize this monthly statement into 3 bullets focusing on unusual charges, recurring subscriptions, and balance changes.
statement: [REDACTED TRANSACTION LIST]
```

aisha_se: Security/Qs: we can provide Private (VPC) deployment or Hosted with tenant isolation. Orchard requires customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest and a monthly audit log export. We need to confirm whether they need data retention beyond 90 days and whether PII can be redacted before being logged. Also flagged a legal question about model training data — we must confirm we don't train on customer-provided data.

nora_pricing: Pricing note: If POC stays hosted and under 15 rps with burst allowance, we can do a time-limited credit + overage pricing. If they want Dedicated/reserved for month-end peaks and SLAs, estimate: 1x A10-equivalent pool with autoscale to 2x during bursts — ballpark $XXk/month for POC (will convert to exact numbers after we get RPS and token profile). Need confirmation on expected concurrent KV cache sizes and sequence lengths to refine.

maria_sales: Action items I hear: 
- jon_engineering: produce minimal endpoint definitions and sample payloads for the 3 prioritized journeys (by tomorrow noon).
- caleb_solutions: draft eval testset (30–50 examples per journey) + human rating rubric (by Thu).
- aisha_se: prepare short answers for security questionnaire sections: KMS, data retention, training-use policy, and provide audit-log export cadence (by Thu).
- nora_pricing: rough POC pricing sheet for Hosted vs Dedicated options (by Thu EOD).

jon_engineering: I’ll drop endpoint stubs here, e.g.: 
```json
POST /v1/support-triage
{ "model":"redwood-7b", "input":"<ticket text>", "max_tokens":150 }

POST /v1/statement-summary
{ "model":"redwood-13b-quant", "input":"<statement blob>", "max_tokens":300 }

POST /v1/fraud-explain
{ "model":"redwood-7b", "input":"<tx details> + ruleset", "mask_pii": true }
```

jon_engineering: Note: for summarization recommend a larger quantized candidate and aggressive prefix caching. We'll include example batching configs.

aisha_se: One more from security: procurement_bot flagged requirement for ISO 27001 certificate. I’ll confirm if Hosted region they want is covered by our existing compliance posture and add a short note on minimal network controls for Private deployment.

procurement_bot: reminder: Orchard Finance requested legal & DPA checklist before POC kickoff; procurement contact is sara@orchardfinance.com, targeted procurement completion by 2026-04-10.

maria_sales: Great — this is actionable. If we can get the endpoint stubs + eval seeds by tomorrow, I’ll schedule a joint alignment call with Orchard for Friday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jon_engineering: Will do.

caleb_solutions: On it — I’ll also include a small manual test harness for human raters.

nora_pricing: I’ll send a draft pricing matrix and two expenditure scenarios (hosted credit vs dedicated reservation) in the thread when ready.

aisha_se: Uploading draft answers and controls doc later today.

maria_sales: Closing loop — please @mention when you’ve uploaded docs so I can pull them into the customer folder.
